messages:
Jamal: Heads up — DeployBot scheduled v2 rollout to eu-west tonight 23:00 UTC. Need operator handoff and decision on how to handle v1 clients that still call old endpoint. @ops-oncall FYI

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] v2 rollout (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. To cancel: /deploy cancel 1890456789

Maria: Do we have a pin strategy? Some mobile SDK users still sending v1 header. Can we auto-fallback to v1 when incompatible?

Sophia: Recommend header fallback + soft-schema check. If mismatch, route to v1 with X-Compat-Proxy header. Example:
```
if req.headers['X-API-Version'] != 'v2': route('v1')
```

Alex: Also suggest temporary tenant throttle at edge during ramp: set route_throttle=0.5 for 1hr. Rollback plan: abort canary and flip traffic to v1 via gateway toggle. Steps in runbook.

ops-oncall: I can take handoff at 22:45 UTC. Please add me to the deploybot eyes list and put rollback checklist in release notes. :thumbsup:

Jamal: Added ops-oncall, will include rollback checklist + curl sample for toggling gateway.

Jamal: curl for quick rollback:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api/release/toggle -d '{"route":"/api","version":"v1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
```

Maria: Also adding a quick note to release notes about deprecated v1 behavior and contact for partners.

Sophia: Canary windows: 15m canary -> 45m slow ramp -> monitor 5xx/cost/latency. If error rate > 1% for 5m, abort. 

Alex: I'll prepare the gateway toggle and throttle patch. ops-oncall, will DM you the exact rollback command.

ops-oncall: Received. I'll monitor logs and cpu metrics during rollout.

Jamal: OK — agreed. Everyone please be on call 22:45-00:15 UTC. Final signoff? :white_check_mark:
